content.short: Penguin is a Solana-based treasury and liquidity protocol.
content.description: Founded by Frostbyte, Penguin Finance is a treasury and liquidity protocol on Solana. It enables projects to purchase liquidity as bonds to stay afloat and diversify treasuries even during bearish markets. Penguin also rewards loyal community members with staking rewards, helping align incentives and participation. In addition, it integrates with Jupiter to leverage its router for its trading pool, enhancing liquidity management and execution within its ecosystem.
